title: Undercover
caption: Undercover (V)
lore: The Empire maintains a network of spies attempting to infiltrate the Rebel Alliance or disinform their operatives.
game_text: Deploy on your spy at a site. Spy is now Undercover. During your control phase, may ▲ one Informant. At same and related sites, opponent’s {lightsaber} weapon destiny draws are -1 (-2 if targeting this character). {alter}
